page_title: NAP 2-0 SAS | Napoli v Sassuolo 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Antonio Giua has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+2' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Andrea Consigli is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Juan Jesus will be replaced by Leo Ostigard (Napoli).
87' A lofted cross from Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
85' Stanislav Lobotka comes off the pitch to be replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
83' Rudi Garcia prepares a substitution. Giacomo Raspadori is replaced by Eljif Elmas (Napoli).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Piotr Zielinski departs the field of play to be replaced by Jens Cajuste (Napoli).
82' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
80' Juan Jesus (Napoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
77' Napoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nedim Bajrami walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo).
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
75' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
72' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
70' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
69' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' Alessio Dionisi is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Andrea Pinamonti suffers an injury and Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) comes on.
67' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
66' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

64' 2 - 0 Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 2:0.
61' Substitution. Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo) has come on for Armand Lauriente.
61' Substitution. Matteo Politano makes his way off the pitch and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) comes on as his replacement.
61' Alessio Dionisi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Uros Racic (Sassuolo) replacing Daniel Boloca.
61' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matias Vina.
60' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) failed to score from the penalty kick.
59' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
58' Handball! A player from Sassuolo handled the ball. The referee gives a penalty kick to Napoli!!
57' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

56' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Napoli are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
53' Dangerous play by Victor Osimhen (Napoli). Antonio Giua blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Maxime Lopez (Sassuolo) has received a red card for dissent. He probably didn't measure his words as much as he should have and that got him sent off.
49' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
48' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
47' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Maxime Lopez (Sassuolo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45+3' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
45+1' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
44' Sassuolo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
41' Looks like Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
39' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
37' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
36' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
35' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
33' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
33' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
30' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
26' A cooling break is underway.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
23' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
23' Napoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
20' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
19' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
16' 1 - 0 Victor Osimhen (Napoli) steps up and confidently directs the penalty into the left side of the goal!
16' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
15' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!

14' Play continues despite the shouts by some Napoli players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Antonio Giua interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
13' Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
12' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
11' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
9' The referee blows his whistle as Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) was too aggressive in his challenge.
8' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) commits a rough challenge and Antonio Giua blows his whistle for an infringement.
5' An attempted cross from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is cleared.
3' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
1' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Napoli will have the kick-off.
